kop3: Did you fall onto your shoulder or outstretched hand, and is your shoulder now swollen or out of shape? Most broken collarbones heal without surgery, with a sling. Healing takes about 6–8 weeks in adults and 3–4 weeks in children. During this time, elbow, hand and shoulder exercises prevent stiffness and help you start using your arm again.

kop37: A lump forming over the break is expected. It shrinks within 12 months, but a small lump may remain.
